title: 第304章 入土为安
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“不会了，再也不会来了！”

田曼琪激灵地站起身，领着人们就往外跑。

跑到一半，她像忽然想起来什么似的，“大家把三具尸体带上，这都是我们出生入死的家人，得入土为安。”

田曼琪的话一出口，部分人生生停住了脚步。

他们知道田曼琪的意思，三人一人能分一大块肉。

葛壮率先上前，将还有一口气的人背到背上，往外走。

其他人力气没那么大，两人抬一个，将人抬出去。

并不敢像往常一样，只拽着脚踝走。

出了庇护所大门，他们本想直接往小院走，被田曼琪叫住了：“往哪走？往大河边去！”

一群人假模假样地往夏洼村外面走，周凛带着士兵搜查了一圈庇护所，确保庇护所里没有余党，就站在庇护所门口看着他们离开。

蹲在围墙外的鞋耙子脸，听到里面传出枪声，吓得一个哆嗦，他不敢动。

直到过了很久，他也没看到有人往农家小院那边跑。

难道都被抓走了？还是跑到别的地方去了？

鞋耙子脸不清楚，他弯着腰往小院的方向跑，运气好，一路上也没遇到什么人。

他到达小院的时候，里面有十几人了。

他们都是趁乱先跑回来的。

屋里的人咀嚼着，笑着。

“哈哈，他们肯定完蛋了，咱们先把这肉吃了，到时候看看尸体埋在哪再挖出来。”

“不愁吃了，还好咱们哥几个机灵。”

鞋拔子脸嘿嘿一笑：“嘿嘿，他们回不来了？快快，给我也来一块！”

鞋拔子脸挤过去从袋子里又抢了块肉，这次不用着急吃，他小口小口咀嚼，满嘴油香。

几人吃得撑破肚皮，吃掉了三分之二。

要是40多人吃饱，这些可能将将才够。

可他们只有十几人，撑破肚皮也是吃不完的。

田曼琪等人见周凛收了兵，又迅速找山路折返回来。

等她们到了农家小院，热得头晕眼花，濒临在中暑边缘。

门口传来响动，屋里的人往外望去，却发现大部队都回来了。

他们慌了神，赶忙擦手又擦脚，鞋拔子脸最机灵，将肉塞回了柜子里。

田曼琪一进屋就觉得不对劲：

"No, never again!"

Tian Manqi stood up excitedly and led people to run outside.

Halfway through the run, she seemed to suddenly remember something, "Everyone, bring the three corpses with you. These are our family members who have been through life and death. They must be laid to rest."

As soon as Tian Manqi's words came out, some people stopped in their tracks.

They knew what Tian Manqi meant. Each of the three of them could share a large piece of meat.

Ge Zhuang stepped forward first, carried the still breathing man on his back, and walked out.

The others were not that strong, so one of them carried the person out.

I didn't dare to just walk by my ankles as usual.

After leaving the shelter gate, they wanted to go directly to the courtyard, but Tian Manqi stopped them: "Where to go? Towards the river!"

A group of people pretended to be walking outside Xiawa Village. Zhou Lin led the soldiers to search a circle of shelters to ensure that there were no survivors in the shelters, and then stood at the door of the shelter and watched them leave.

Shoe Raekian, who was squatting outside the fence, shivered in fear when he heard the gunshots coming from inside. He didn't dare to move.

Until a long time later, he didn't see anyone running towards the farmyard.

Have they all been taken away?Or went somewhere else?

The shoe rake's face was unclear. He bent down and ran towards the small courtyard. Fortunately, he didn't meet anyone along the way.

When he arrived at the small courtyard, there were more than a dozen people inside.

They all took advantage of the chaos and ran back first.

People in the room were chewing and laughing.

"Haha, they must be finished. Let's eat the meat first, and then we can find where the body is buried and then dig it out."

"Don't worry about eating. Fortunately, our brothers are smart."

The shoehorned face chuckled: "Hey, they can't come back? Come on, give me a piece!"

Shoehorn Face squeezed over and grabbed another piece of meat from the bag. This time, he didn't have to rush to eat it. He chewed it in small bites, and his mouth was filled with oil and fragrance.

Several people ate until their bellies burst and ate two-thirds of the food.

If more than 40 people are fed, this may be enough.

But there were only a dozen of them, and they couldn’t eat enough to burst their bellies.

Seeing Zhou Lin withdrew his troops, Tian Manqi and others quickly found a mountain road and turned back.

When they arrived at the farmyard, they were dizzy from the heat and on the verge of heatstroke.

There was a noise at the door, and the people in the room looked out, only to find that all the troops were back.

They panicked and hurriedly wiped their hands and feet. Shoehorn was the smartest person and stuffed the meat back into the cabinet.

Tian Manqi felt something was wrong as soon as she entered the room:
